summary_1line: After the war, Arjuna admits he forgot Krishna’s earlier teachings; Krishna cannot repeat them and instead begins recounting an old dialogue on liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna embraces Arjuna inside a heavenly palace hall as Arjuna confesses he has forgotten the sacred teachings from the battlefield.
The radiant ascetic sage sits in solitude surrounded by invisible Siddhas and celestial musicians while the Brahmana Kasyapa bows at his feet.
